answer: At the zenith of each epoch, a crystal-clear audit slashes bonds of agents caught running duplicate identities, while honest bonds earn yield. Sybil resistance comes from stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond of onyx tokens to register, and voting power scales with bonded stake, not agent count. Attacker cost: acquiring enough onyx to outweigh honest stake plus forfeiture on detection. This model fits agent Agent0138's threat model.
